facts.fact: 章首：狐狸吵得他半宿没睡——这该死的东西不冬眠吗
facts.anchor: Foxes kept me awake half the night. Don’t the damn things hibernate?

facts.fact: 雪不真实几乎人工——让他想起凭空出现的网球
facts.anchor: Below it the snow looked almost unreal, almost artificial, and it made him think of those tennis balls that had appeared from nowhere

facts.fact: 雪人的红苹果嘴消失了——也许掉了，也许被鸟叼走
facts.anchor: One morning he walked up to check and saw that the apple slice had disappeared; fallen, perhaps, or taken by birds.

facts.fact: Lucy 的来访让他对陪伴有了渴望——全书最重要的情感转折
facts.anchor: And yet Lucy’s visit had given him an appetite for company.

facts.fact: 荒原上的石头像蹲坐的巨人
facts.anchor: rusty-looking boulders like squatting giants in the snow.

facts.fact: 硫磺色天空，地平线像边缘被擦掉的粉笔画
facts.anchor: That sky – that yellowish, sulphurous light. And that uncertain horizon, like a chalk drawing from which the edges had been erased.

facts.fact: 路人说：没人住那里——男人杀了他三十年的妻子
facts.anchor: ‘No one lives there,’ he said again. ‘No one since the tragedy. Man killed his wife of thirty years. No one wants to live there now.’

facts.fact: Arthur 把 Caroline 关在门外冻死——她的手血肉模糊、全是敲门敲烂的
facts.anchor: Shut her out of the house to freeze to death in the middle of winter. Made out it was an accident, but folk round here knew better. Heard her hands were all bloody and torn from knocking and knocking at the door.

facts.fact: 路人说 Arthur 逍遥法外——他精神失常，不知道自己做了什么
facts.anchor: ‘Got off scot-free. They said he wasn’t of sound mind. Didn’t even know what he’d done.’

facts.fact: 他日记：我独自一人，这里只有鬼魂和雪
facts.anchor: I am alone. Nothing here but ghosts and snow.

facts.fact: 路人说他从没听说过 Lyke——他走了两个月的村子不存在
facts.anchor: ‘Lyke,’ he repeated slowly. ‘Lyke. Can’t say I’ve ever heard of it.’

facts.fact: 路人：这里附近没有叫这个名字的地方
facts.anchor: ‘There’s no place of that name near here.’
